items.text: The London naval treaty, which in large measure will eliminate world competition in naval building for the next five years, today began to take shape in definite written form. A draft was rushed into shape by the drafting and expert committees throughout the day in the hope of submitting it to the delegates by midnight. It can thus be studied over Sunday. .— The Turkish Parliament at Angora today ratified the Turko-American treaty on commerce, which already has been ratified by the United States Senate. The treaty will become applicable immediately.
